offer.text: I want to do something for YOU for once. Help me bake — bring 8 cookies and we'll have a little party, just the two of us and whoever wanders by.

accept.text: A party! Oh, it's been an age since I had a reason to smile.

decline.text: Another day, then. I'll save you a seat regardless.

in_progress.text: Are the cookies coming? I dusted off the good plates!

ready.text: Cookies, friends, and an old fool grinning ear to ear!

complete.text: You turned my quiet little life around. Take this — it was my dearest friend's, long ago. I'd like you to have it now.
